correctness.rationale: PASS: Monomial counting on Bl_{P^k} P5 gives Euler polynomial C_k(s,r); anticanonical subtraction P(t)=C_k(ta,tb)-C_k(ta-6,tb-(4-k)). The four displayed A_k t^4+B_k t^2+2 identities and discriminant positive-coefficient polynomials in b>0,u=a-b>0 were independently checked against direct monomial counts for 48 parameter/twist cases, supplementing exact finite-sum identities. A,B>0 and B²-8A>0 imply two distinct negative t² roots and thus four simple purely imaginary Hilbert roots. HRR yields (c2.L²)²>192 L⁴. Adjunction/Kodaira show smooth anticanonical members are CY4, restricted ample classes exactly within asserted ambient cone.
